instruction: Access the United Airlines check-in page.

metadata.explanation: Task requires navigating to the United Airlines check-in page. Similar complexity to original task - simple navigation on the same website. Uses existing metric 'is_expected_url_pattern_match' to verify URL.
metadata.similarity_to_original: high - same website, similar navigation pattern

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly uses active_tab_info getter to extract the active tab URL from Chrome's address bar via accessibility tree
Metric is_expected_url_pattern_match correctly performs regex pattern matching on the URL
Expected pattern 'united.com/en/us/checkin' semantically matches the instruction requirement to access United Airlines check-in page
Data flow is correct: getter extracts URL -> metric checks pattern match -> expected value is appropriate
Coverage is complete for this simple navigation task - only URL verification is needed

Minor issue: Pattern matching uses substring search (re.search) without anchors, which could allow false positives from URLs like 'evil.com/phishing?redirect=united.com/en/us/checkin' - should use more strict URL validation
Minor issue: goto_prefix assumption 'https://www.' might be incorrect if the address bar already shows the full URL with scheme
No verification that page actually loaded successfully - only URL is checked, not page content or state
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Consider using stricter URL pattern with anchors (e.g., '^https?://(www\.)?united\.com/en/us/checkin/?$') to prevent false positives
Consider validating the URL structure more carefully instead of substring matching
Optionally add page content verification to ensure the check-in page actually loaded (not just URL navigation)
